attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Shattered Empire still holds nine settlements and is still at war with the Ashford Compact.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"still\" implies ongoing status; briefing gives the current war and count, so this is nearly supported"},{"span":"The Kestrel Tribe keeps its four settlements and, as far as I can tell, its own counsel.","severity":"minor","reason":"ongoing quiet behaviour not in briefing, though hedged with \"as far as I can tell\""}],"voice":4,"clarity":4,"tone":4,"overall":4,"comment":"A solid quiet-week bulletin that comments drily on faction sizes and the date, with guesses properly hedged and no invented names or numbers. It runs slightly short on sharp wit, and \"still\" implies a continuing status the briefing does not report."}
